items.question: What posture and action must the skilled practitioner adopt when performing the full oblation?
premises: The skilled practitioner places the right foot forward.
The full oblation is the prescribed ritual act.
The preparatory posture accompanies the performance of the oblation.
items.inference: Therefore, the skilled practitioner should perform the full oblation while placing the right foot forward.
items.plain_english: Placing the right foot forward, the skilled practitioner should perform the full oblation.
